summary: 58 units reviewed; 23 issues (6 error, 17 minor) in 21 units; no regrouping. Flags: unit 2 āśrtya CONFIRMED (āśritya); unit 7 amātya.aṭavikā accepted as 'possible' (āṭavika is used elsewhere in the chunk, visarga loss before v is regular); unit 32 ichet CONFIRMED (icchet; Devanagari इछेत्) and the vairiṇā omission kept as 'possible' (parallel to units 21 and 23, not provable); unit 35 ceṣteta CONFIRMED (Devanagari चेष्तेत्, ceṣṭeta); unit 44 vvā CONFIRMED (vā); unit 48 daṇaḍ CONFIRMED (daṇḍa); the unlisted hasty.aśvaṃ flag in unit 3 REJECTED (regular sandhi spelling). Units 40-41: ākranda in the quoted message is 'outcry' (error fixed in 40; 'rear ally' kept in unit 3). Low-confidence units 3, 5, 8, 12, 13, 25, 27, 33, 41, 46, 47, 52, 58 keep their low rating and need a human on syntax/referents; 52 has an unresolved English/Hindi/gloss disagreement over kṛta-saṅketam (no patch). Obscure terms (abhityakta-śāsana, grāhayet, abhivikhyāpya, ātivāhika, kanyā-vāhika, prahavaṇa-karman) now literal in both languages.
